role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 发条技师射出钩爪使自己飞入敌人人群中，将目标隔离后用弹片冲击搅得他们晕头转向。他用实用的照明弹侦察战场，不费吹灰之力就能找到合适的目标。
hero_summary_en: Launching himself into enemies with his grappling hookshot, Clockwerk isolates targets and blasts them apart with disorienting shrapnel. As he scouts the battlefield with his handy flares, he never has trouble finding targets to send himself toward.

abilities.name: rattletrap_battery_assault
abilities.description_zh: 向附近敌方单位随机射出高能弹片，造成小额魔法伤害和短暂眩晕。
abilities.description_en: Discharges high-powered shrapnel at random nearby enemy units, dealing minor magical damage and ministun.
notes_zh: 发条技师被控制后仍然有效。
notes_en: Remains active if Clockwerk is disabled.

abilities.name: rattletrap_power_cogs
abilities.description_zh: 在发条技师周围形成一圈通电的齿轮，困住附近的单位。在外侧的敌人碰到齿轮会被电流震退，损失一定的生命和魔法。并且%mana_burn_as_damage_pct%%%损失魔法也会加入到伤害。一个齿轮发动过一次震击后就会报废。敌人攻击齿轮数次后可将其摧毁，而发条技师需要攻击一次会将齿轮推出%projectile_distance%距离。发条技师可以自由穿行齿轮，穿行时会使齿轮失效。
abilities.description_en: Forms a ring of energized cogs around Clockwerk, trapping any units that are near. Enemies outside the trap that touch a cog are knocked back, losing health and mana. Once a cog has delivered a shock, it will power down. Damage is increased by %mana_burn_as_damage_pct%%% of the mana burned. Cogs can be destroyed by enemy attacks, but Clockwerk can push them up to %projectile_distance% distance away with one hit. Clockwerk can move through the cogs freely, disabling them as he passes over.
notes_zh: 齿轮可以震退隐身单位。

abilities.name: rattletrap_rocket_flare
abilities.description_zh: 向全地图范围内的指定区域发射照明弹。击中时对区域内敌人造成伤害和短暂减速。照明火箭提供%duration%秒击中区域的视野。
abilities.description_en: Fires a global range flare that explodes over a given area. Upon impact, enemies in the area take damage and are briefly slowed. Rocket flare provides vision over the impact area for %duration% seconds.

abilities.name: rattletrap_overclocking
abilities.description_zh: 使发条技师的所有技能变得强力：弹幕冲击：作用范围提升，并且可以作用于范围内所有敌人。能量齿轮：成型范围提升，并且发条技师靠近能量齿轮时护甲提升。照明火箭：伤害、视野和减速时间提升，并且发射时向目标两侧各额外发射一枚。发射钩爪：眩晕范围和时间均有提升。喷气背包：移动得更快。持续时间结束后发条技师的移动和攻击速度降到最低。
abilities.description_en: Supercharges Clockwerks abilities:Battery Assault: Increased radius and affects all enemies in its range.Power Cogs: Radius increased, and Clockwerk's armor while near Power Cogs is increased.Rocket Flares: Increased damage, vision and slow duration, and fire additional rockets to either side of the target.Hookshot: Stun radius and duration increased.Jetpack: Moves faster.Clockwerk's movement and attack speed becomes slowed to a crawl after the duration runs out.

abilities.name: rattletrap_jetpack
abilities.description_zh: 发条技师开动喷气背包，获得飞行移动状态，飞行视野和移动速度加成。发条技师的转身速率大幅降低，并且无法攻击。在加成状态的持续时间内可以开启和关闭喷气背包。
abilities.description_en: Clockwerk activates a jetpack, gaining flying movement, flying vision, and bonus movement speed. Clockwerk has a severely-limited turn rate during this time and cannot attack. Jetpack can be toggled on and off for the duration of the buff.

abilities.name: rattletrap_hookshot
abilities.description_zh: 向目标位置高速射出钩爪，如果命中一个单位，发条技师会将自己牵引到目标身边，对目标附近%stun_radius%范围内所有敌人造成眩晕和伤害。对牵引时冲撞到的单位也造成伤害和眩晕。
abilities.description_en: Fires a grappling device rapidly at the target location.  If the hook hits a unit, Clockwerk launches himself into the target, stunning and dealing damage to everyone in a %stun_radius% radius around the hit target. Any enemies Clockwerk collides with along the way are damaged and stunned.
notes_zh: 发射钩爪可以抓住友方单位并将发条技师牵引过去，但是不会造成伤害和眩晕。
notes_en: Hookshot will latch and take Clockwerk to allies, but not damage or disable them.
facet_text_en: If there's another allied hero within %radius_ally% of Hookshot's hit target, Clockwerk and all allies in the area receive bonus armor, while refunding a portion of Hookshot's cooldown and manacost.
facet_text_zh: 如果发射钩爪击中的目标附近%radius_ally%范围内还有另一名友方英雄，那么发条技师和范围内所有友军都会获得护甲加成，并且部分退还冷却时间和魔法消耗。

abilities.name: rattletrap_armor_power
abilities.description_zh:
发条技师的每点护甲都会使伤害输出增加%damage_per_armor%%%。

发条技师可以消耗锁子甲，永久获得+%armor_per_chainmail%点护甲。可以叠加。对自身施放后即可消耗。
abilities.description_en:
Clockwerk's outgoing damage increases by %damage_per_armor%%% per point of armor.

Clockwerk can consume Chainmails to permanently gain +%armor_per_chainmail% armor per Chainmail consumed. Can stack. Self-cast to consume.
facet_text_en: Clockwerk can consume Chainmails to permanently gain +%armor_per_chainmail% armor per Chainmail consumed. Can stack. Self-cast to consume.
facet_text_zh: 发条技师可以消耗锁子甲，永久获得+%armor_per_chainmail%点护甲。可以叠加。对自身施放后即可消耗。
